# `get_server_log`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

File channel: read the device server log and return it.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, imager file table (serves 4801), handler @0x1f1880 (64-bit build), @0x186be4 (32-bit build); static analysis of app 3.3.2, LogUploadEntity command builder (stored JSON command, id 4) queued on AlbumFileSocketManager (port 4801), reply renamed to a local .zip; log-move helper SvrLogMove @0x1ed100 (path formatting only, memcpy/strlen; no rename/open/unlink observed), GetFileSize/ReadFile, IMG_DATA::ReallocBinBuf, reponse_result; log collection (dmesg, dhcpcd journal last 5000 lines, dnsmasq) and "sudo zip -s 40m -r svr_log.zip"; old svr_log.* archive removed before zipping; captures redirected into log files |

File-channel (4801) method. Collects kernel, DHCP-client (last 5000 journal lines) and DNS/DHCP-server logs, zips the log folders in 40 MB split parts, reads the archive into a request-local buffer and sends it as a binary reply (imgType 6, dataType 3). READ. A log-move helper is called first; its visible body only formats a path string, so no log rotation or move is established; whether it rotates logs on another path is unresolved. The zip archive and log captures are scratch writes on device storage (READ), so the method is a MUTATOR with observation-safe (tier B) effects; it writes logs and a scratch archive but changes no hardware, setting or visible state. The 32-bit build matches (READ).

Side effects: Collects system and network logs, writes a split zip archive of the log folders (scratch file), reads it into a reallocated request-local buffer and responds. No log rotation or move is established. Removes the previous archive before zipping. READ.
